meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的代码库，提取业务领域、流程和步骤，并生成一个交互式的水平流程图。
howto.when: 当你要求分析代码库的业务领域，或使用 /understand-domain 命令时触发。如果已有知识图谱，会直接从中提取；否则会进行轻量扫描。

say.text: 分析这个项目的业务领域
say.note: 触发轻量扫描并生成领域流程图。

say.text: 用 --full 重新扫描并生成领域图
say.note: 强制重新扫描，忽略已有知识图谱。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your codebase to extract business domains, flows, and process steps, then generates an interactive horizontal flow graph.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze business domains or use the /understand-domain command. If a knowledge graph exists, it derives from it; otherwise performs a lightweight scan.

say_en.text: Analyze the business domains of this project
say_en.note: Triggers a lightweight scan and generates a domain flow graph.

say_en.text: Re-scan with --full and generate domain graph
say_en.note: Forces a fresh scan, ignoring any existing knowledge graph.
